name: Pull table sample
description: Bounded SELECT (1–25 rows) from one table on connectors-private-512 (postgres-private-sample/1). Saves to connector sample_payloads. Does not start CDC or ingest. Use Preview table rows for preview-only.

entity_type.description: Table name from postgres_list_tables or GET /entities (e.g. public.workflow_node_runs).

instance_id.description: Required when the org has more than one instance.
